items.title: File Widerspruch against partial refusal of window permit
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Hansestadt Beispielwismar, Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (and presumed date of posting, Aufgabe zur Post) = 19.11.2026 (Thursday). The letter states the decision 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V). Counting the 4th day after posting: day 1 = 20.11 (Fri), day 2 = 21.11 (Sat), day 3 = 22.11 (Sun), day 4 = 23.11 (Mon). Since 23.11.2026 is a normal weekday (no Saturday/Sunday/holiday adjustment needed), Bekanntgabe (deemed notification) = 23.11.2026 (Monday). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from this date per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of the event (23.11.) itself is not counted as day 1, but the monthly period ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in MV, so no further shift is required. Final deadline: the Widerspruch must reach the authority by 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter cites a 4-day fiction-of-delivery rule ('gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post') for a simple letter; the standard rule under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (and its M-V counterpart) is normally the third day, so you may want to double-check this specific provision with the authority, though the calculated Widerspruchsfrist end date (23.12.2026) would be the same even under a 3-day rule since 22.11 falls on a Sunday and shifts to the next business day (23.11) in both cases.
No deadline or amount is given for the mentioned subsidy ('Zuschuss') for wooden windows; you would need to apply and ask the authority about any application deadline.
